title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of NbTaTiV refractory high-entropy alloys prepared by powder metallurgy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high purity (>99.5 wt%) Nb, Ta, Ti and V powders in equiatomic composition for 12 h in argon atmosphere, then consolidated through spark plasma sintering at 1700°C for 30 min under 30 MPa pressure
